main_text.p: & crudeli modo fpoliarunt, ut ipfas ctiam Ter-ras Ecclefiæ venales habuerint, & ab omni Sa-cro ufu in perpetuum abalienandas; Eam vim habent fluxus temporum, & præpotentia Partium in nonnullorum hominum judicia, qui ut fic jam repente & penitus mutarentur, nullam aliam poffunt caufam afferre, quàm, quòd Scotorum Exercitus jam in Anglium ve-niffet.

At fe olim caftigabit horum hominum ful-titia, & defertores Epifcopatus fibi ipfis non minus inimici, & rem fuam prodidiffe depre-hendentur: nunquam enim vel ipfe Presbyte-ratus vim illam aut pretium feorfum obtinebit, ac fuiffet Epifcopatui conjuncto & eodem qua-fi coronato: Ut vero fecundior fit Miniftris au-ra populi, quàm Principis Gratiæ[?], æquè parum fperari debet, ac, ut crefcant fælicius plantæ manu rigatę illis rore cęlefti dulci & libera-li perfufis. Quin inopia & contemptus cle-ri oftendent, quale jam cadaver fupererunt, cùm à Capitis Iilius[?] influentia, in cujus Pri-matum jurárunt, dimoventur.

Modico interea temperamento adhibito, occurri forfan potuiffet magnis malis. Id in-terim fixum eft mihi, Epi fcopatum illum Pri-mitivum quantum in Me eft extirpandum non pati: facile reformabit Prudentia affectibus incorrupta, quicquid temporum ærugo, vel indulgentia Legum, vel corruptela Morum induxit: vitia Perfonarum aut Temporum toti or-dini imputare, vel propterea in poenam depof-cere,

page.notes: The star before "terim" is printed at the left edge of the text block with no note text beside it, so it is kept as a bare star in the text. "Gratiæ" and "Iilius" are uncertain in the scan and are marked [?]. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The word "Epi fcopatum" is printed with a space and is kept as printed.
